pictures.scene: Erik Henningsen, A Wounded Worker - the injured workman carried in on the stretcher with the bandage wound about his head, his wife fallen on her knees beside him weeping into his hand, the man in the bowler hat laying a hand on her shoulder and the policeman standing at the left, the pale sky filling the top of the picture, a song of ascents, in my distress I cried to the LORD and He answered me
pictures.name: pd_henningsen_nood

pictures.scene: Vasily Vereshchagin, The Spy - the captured man in the bowler hat and the white waistcoat brought down the steps into the yard, the officers standing above him and the soldiers drawn up below with their bayoneted rifles, the sunlit cracked white wall standing over the whole scene, deliver my soul O LORD from lying lips and a deceitful tongue, what will He do to you and what will be added to you O deceitful tongue
pictures.name: pd_vereshchagin_spion

pictures.scene: Franz Roubaud, Caucasian Riders - the tribesman in the blue coat and the white turban sitting his chestnut horse on the stony plain with the rifle slung across his back, a second armed rider waiting behind him, the bare pink mountains standing along the whole horizon, sharp arrows will come from the warrior with burning coals of the broom tree, woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar, too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace
pictures.name: pd_roubaud_ruiters

pictures.scene: Laurits Andersen Ring, Road in the Village of Baldersbronde on a Winter Day - the empty village road running out under the snow with the cart tracks curving away across it, the white farmhouse with the snow on its thatch standing at the left and the bare tree and the clipped hedge at the right, the still grey winter sky filling the whole upper half, I am in favor of peace, but when I speak they want war
pictures.name: pd_ring_winterweg

lines.text: In my distress I cried to the LORD,
from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
What will He do to you,
and what will be added to you,
Sharp arrows will come from the warrior,
with burning coals of the broom tree!
Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech,
that I live among the tents of Kedar!
I am in favor of peace;
but when I speak, they want war.
